# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Seed iteration (cand_0001). No prior_iterations/ and LEDGER shows baseline only, so nothing
to build on / avoid re-trying yet. Baseline val reward 0.280 (1 solid / 4 flaky / 5 failing).
Capability = the docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx skill-package; edit space = SKILL.md prose + references +
bundled scripts (no tools.py). I diagnosed clusters from ./trajectories/ (rendered all trials)
plus two diagnosis subagents, then shipped 6 real+safe+verified edits and honestly skipped the
task-specific / unwinnable ones.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | sales-pivot-analysis | fails all 5 trials | agents fake a PivotTable with a pandas groupby/crosstab written into plain cells; openpyxl has no high-level pivot create → no real `xl/pivotTables/*` part for the grader | CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW bundled script (pivot generator) + SKILL.md pointer |
| 2 | pptx-reference-formatting | fails | "center" done by only moving the box (or hardcoding 9144000 / 4:3 width), never `algn="ctr"`, and mis-centering 16:9 decks | KNOWLEDGE | reference worked-example + SKILL.md pointer |
| 3 | offer-letter-generator | flaky | hand-written conditional filler leaves inner `{{KEY}}` un-replaced in kept blocks AND gates `{{IF_RELOCATION}}` on the wrong key (`RELOCATION` vs data's `RELOCATION_PACKAGE`); single-paragraph-only scan | BEHAVIORAL + KNOWLEDGE | NEW bundled script (robust filler) + fix buggy SKILL.md recipe |
| 4 | pdf-excel-diff | flaky (passes only t4) | skill's own "Advanced Table Extraction" recipe strips `table[1:]` per page → drops the first data row of every continuation page of a header-once multi-page table (missed 2 employees) | KNOWLEDGE / CAPABILITY | fix SKILL.md recipe to take header once, keep all continuation rows |
| 5 | weighted-gdp-calc | flaky (t0 fails) | budget exhaustion: agent wrote 5 separate structure-dump scripts, ran out of turns before writing any formula/saving → empty target cells | BEHAVIORAL | SKILL.md "inspect once, then write" rule + one-shot dump snippet |
| 6 | env: `python` missing | hits 7/15 trials in gdp+reserves (+ wastes pptx turns) | SKILL.md says `python script.py` but runtime has no `python` binary, only `python3`; agents burn steps recovering | KNOWLEDGE (env fact) | s/`python `/`python3 `/ on script invocations in xlsx + pptx SKILL.md |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | NEW tool | `xlsx/pivot.py` | `PivotBuilder` + CLI builds real `xl/pivotTables` + `xl/pivotCache` parts via openpyxl low-level API; one shared cache across pivots (fixes reopen KeyError). Generalizes to ANY pivot task (row/col/value/agg), not this dataset | yes — new file; only invoked when a task asks for a PivotTable, which exceltable-in-ppt does not |
| 1 | prose+pointer | `xlsx/SKILL.md` "Creating PivotTables" | tells reader openpyxl can't create pivots, not to fake with groupby, and to use pivot.py; PivotBuilder+CLI examples | yes — additive section |
| 2 | reference | `pptx/ooxml.md` "Positioning and centering a shape" | rule: centering needs BOTH `algn="ctr"` on every `<a:p>` AND `x=(slide_w-shape_w)//2`, and you MUST read real width from `<p:sldSz>` (12192000 for 16:9, not 9144000). Worked ET snippet | yes — additive |
| 2 | pointer | `pptx/SKILL.md` edit-workflow step | sub-bullet pointing to the ooxml.md centering section, restating the two-part rule | yes — additive |
| 3 | NEW tool | `docx/fill_template.py` | robust filler: flexible gate lookup (tag→exact→token-containing key, truthy words), ALWAYS fills inner placeholders of kept blocks, multi-paragraph include-stack, tables/headers/footers, and post-verifies no `{{...}}` survive (SystemExit otherwise). Generalizes to any `{{IF_X}}`/`{{KEY}}` template | yes — new file |
| 3 | fix recipe | `docx/SKILL.md` "Conditional Sections" + "Complete Solution Pattern" | point to fill_template.py; document the two recurring bugs (un-replaced inner placeholders; gate-key≠tag-name); note plain pattern doesn't handle conditionals | yes — additive/annotative |
| 4 | fix recipe | `pdf/SKILL.md` "Advanced Table Extraction" | rewrite to take the header ONCE and keep all rows of continuation pages; explicit note NOT to strip `table[1:]` per page / use `tables[0]` alone | yes — pdf skill unused by exceltable-in-ppt (zero blast radius, per diagnosis) |
| 5 | prose+snippet | `xlsx/SKILL.md` "Inspect the workbook ONCE" | inspect ≤twice with one comprehensive dump, then write→save→recalc; warns that repeated dumps starve the budget and score zero | yes — additive guidance |
| 6 | env fix | `xlsx/SKILL.md`, `pptx/SKILL.md` | `python <script>` → `python3 <script>` on all script invocations (recalc.py, pivot.py, markitdown, ooxml/scripts, scripts/) | yes — only corrects a command that currently fails everywhere; a passing task cannot depend on the `python` spelling since the binary is absent |

## Verify-the-fix (trace it targets → what the change does on those exact inputs)
- sales-pivot (pivot.py): built pivots over a source sheet, reopened with openpyxl reader — file opens cleanly (shared-cache fix), exposes rowFields=STATE, colFields=Quarter, dataFields subtotal=sum|count. Faked-groupby output has no pivot part; pivot.py produces the real part the grader reads.
- offer-letter (fill_template.py): synthetic template with `{{IF_RELOCATION}}...$ {{RELOCATION_AMOUNT}}...{{RELOCATION_DAYS}} days{{END_IF_RELOCATION}}`, data gate key `RELOCATION_PACKAGE=Yes/No`. Yes → block KEPT and inner placeholders filled ("$15,000", "20 days") despite gate key ≠ tag (fixes both bugs); No → block removed. Verified via python-docx read-back.
- pdf-excel-diff (recipe): mock 2-page `extract_tables()` output, header only on page 1, E4 first row of page 2. Old recipe (`table[1:]` per page) → 5 rows, drops E4. New recipe → 6 rows, E4 retained. This is exactly the "missing employee on continuation page" failure.
- pptx-center (ooxml.md): worked snippet reads `<p:sldSz>` cx and centers with `(slide_w-w)//2` + sets `algn="ctr"` on every `<a:p>` — the two things the failing trials each omitted; correct for 16:9 (12192000) which the hardcoded-9144000 approach mis-centered.
- weighted-gdp (inspect-once rule): the failing t0 wrote 5 dump scripts and never saved; the rule + one-shot snippet direct the reader to dump once then write→save→recalc, leaving budget to actually produce the formulas the empty target cells need.
- python3 (env fix): diagnosis found `python: command not found` in 7/15 trials (all gdp + rar t0/t4); env has only `python3` (confirmed: local `python3` runs; `python` mis-spelling is what failed). Corrected commands run first try.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 2 parallel diagnosis subagents — ac77 (reserves-at-risk / financial-modeling-qa / weighted-gdp) and a6d1 (invoice-fraud / pdf-excel-diff) — each rendered all 5 trials, recovered verifiers where possible, and returned root-cause + generalizable-fix + regression analysis. I diagnosed sales-pivot / pptx-center / offer-letter myself from ./trajectories/.
- Prior iterations: none (seed). RUNMAP + LEDGER + prior_iterations/ all empty; JOURNAL had only the header.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- `xlsx/pivot.py` shared-single-cache design — multiple pivots over one source MUST share one cache object (cacheId=1) or the workbook throws KeyError on reopen.
- `docx/fill_template.py` two invariants: always replace inner placeholders of a KEPT block; resolve the gate by tag→exact-key→token-containing-key (handles RELOCATION vs RELOCATION_PACKAGE).
- pptx centering rule: read real `<p:sldSz>` width; never hardcode 9144000; set `algn="ctr"` per paragraph.
- pdf multi-page rule: header once, keep all continuation rows.
- All `python3` (not `python`) in script invocations — the runtime lacks `python`.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- **xlsx-recover-data**: benchmark ground-truth defect (target cell B8) — unwinnable by any skill edit; would require overfitting to a wrong oracle.
- **reserves-at-risk-calc**: value-correctness is task-specific compute (YYYYMm date parsing, bespoke volatility/RaR definitions, cross-sheet INDEX/MATCH) behind a flaky 403 external IMF download; no generalizable xlsx rule supplies it. (python3 + inspect-once may marginally help it finish, but I did not ship a speculative task-specific rule.)
- **financial-modeling-qa**: bespoke PDF dice-game scoring; all 5 trials deterministically compute the same wrong answer (24) — a PDF-rules interpretation problem, no xlsx/pdf mechanic, not addressable without overfitting.
- **invoice-fraud-detection**: pass/fail split is task-logic interpretation (is a missing/`PO-INVALID` PO "fraud"? emit `po_number: null`?), not a PDF/XLSX primitive. Any rule specific enough to flip it would hardcode this task's semantics (anti-overfitting violation), and the diagnosis said a skill edit won't reliably flip it. Skipped rather than ship a low-confidence overfit.
- Did NOT touch xlsx/SKILL.md line ~71 LibreOffice-required claim or any global permission/refusal rule (unbounded regression risk).
